DEVICE ACCESS
Technical preview
USB devices

When a supported device is connected, the app requests USB access and connects to ADB. Fastboot can read variables and write one explicitly selected raw image after confirmation. Sparse and large images are not supported.

Connect a device with a USB OTG cable, then refresh the list.

Command and preview

Review the plan first. Supported: getvar version/product/max-download-size/partition-size:recovery, ADB device code and fastboot flash with an Android-selected raw image. Flashing requires a second confirmation.
